Key Insights & Recommendations

🎯 Feature Engineering Recommendations

  • Lag Features: Include 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 day lags for prices
  • Rolling Statistics: 7-day and 30-day moving averages and standard deviations
  • Seasonal Indicators: Month, Quarter, Agricultural Season dummies
  • Cyclical Encoding: Sin/Cos transformations for month and day-of-year
  • Weather Lags: 7, 14, 30 day lags for temperature and precipitation
  • Price Changes: First differences alongside price levels
  • Technical Indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands for momentum

🤖 Model Selection Considerations

  • ARIMA/SARIMA: Suitable for univariate forecasting with strong autocorrelation
  • Prophet: Good for capturing multiple seasonalities and holidays
  • ML Models (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM): Leverage engineered features and weather data
  • LSTM/GRU: Capture long-term temporal dependencies
  • Ensemble Methods: Combine time series and ML approaches for robust predictions

✅ Cross-Validation Strategy

  • Use time-based splits (not random) to maintain temporal order
  • Implement walk-forward validation for realistic performance assessment
  • Account for seasonal effects in validation periods
  • Consider location-specific validation for market-specific models

💡 Practical Insights for Stakeholders

  • Price Predictability: Low day-to-day predictability enables short-term forecasting
  • Seasonal Planning: Strong seasonal patterns suggest harvest timing significantly impacts prices
  • Weather Monitoring: Weather conditions 7-30 days prior influence current prices
  • Regional Differences: Each market shows unique temporal patterns requiring localized strategies
  • Trading Strategy: Consider both short-term momentum and long-term seasonal trends
